finding.description: Linux O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW numeric constants were enabled for every Linux architecture even though the ARM64 UAPI uses different values. A non-x86 flag mismatch could omit no-follow and permit outside-root symbolic-link traversal.
finding.resolution: The measured Linux opener and constants are now gated to target_arch=x86_64, with an explicit unsupported directory fallback elsewhere. Caller-owned File parsing and std positioned reads remain separate.

refinement: UTF-16 code-unit length and the 65534-byte native ceiling are preflighted before wide-path allocation; Linux native path encoding is also charged before allocation.
scope: Reviewer found no additional measured-x64 ownership/ABI/native enumeration/index allocation defect under the documented cumulative input/descriptor bounds. This is not a total-process allocation guarantee.
validation: Both hosts debug/release, strict Clippy, deterministic root/component/file swaps, native-stage unwind cleanup, and deliberate follow-symlinks mutation control.
